description: Build the new reusable homepage building-block components and upgrade the news card to be image-rich. This feature creates all standalone pieces; FEAT-003 assembles them into the homepage. Components: (a) LIVE crypto price ticker (client), (b) market data widget, (c) trust signals section, (d) newsletter signup (client), (e) featured hero article + sidebar, (f) a category-colored gradient placeholder helper, and the ArticleCard upgrade. Keep the existing teal (#0f766e) + amber (#b45309) palette, serif headings (font-serif) + sans body, custom component classes from globals.css (.card, .container-page, .section-padding, .btn-primary), and full dark-mode (dark:) support. Everything must be mobile-first responsive.
steps: Create lib/category-styles.ts (or add to an existing helper): export a function getCategoryGradient(slug: string) returning Tailwind gradient classes keyed to the CategoryBadge color scheme (crypto=purple #7c3aed, economy=teal #0f766e, markets=green #16a34a, banking=amber #d97706), with a teal default. This is reused by ArticleCard and the featured hero for placeholder thumbnails. Keep it consistent with the categoryColors map in components/news/CategoryBadge.tsx.

Create components/home/CryptoTicker.tsx as a 'use client' component. On mount, fetch https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price?ids=bitcoin,ethereum,binancecoin,solana,ripple,cardano&vs_currencies=usd&include_24hr_change=true using the browser fetch API inside useEffect, then refresh every 60 seconds via setInterval (clear on unmount). Map ids to display symbols: bitcoin=BTC, ethereum=ETH, binancecoin=BNB, solana=SOL, ripple=XRP, cardano=ADA. Render a full-width dark-background bar (e.g. bg-brand-near-black / bg-brand-charcoal text-zinc-100) with a horizontal scrolling marquee of each coin: SYMBOL, formatted USD price, and 24h change with green (text-green-400 / positive) or red (text-red-400 / negative) color and an up/down arrow. Define a hardcoded FALLBACK price array (realistic static values, e.g. BTC ~78000, ETH ~2400, BNB ~680, SOL ~100, XRP ~1.30, ADA ~0.19) used for the initial render AND whenever the fetch throws or returns a non-ok response, so the ticker NEVER breaks the page. Implement the marquee with a CSS animation (see next step) and duplicate the coin list once so the scroll loops seamlessly; pause animation on hover is a nice touch but optional. Ensure it works on mobile (the marquee should scroll; do not require horizontal user scrolling).

Add the marquee animation: in tailwind.config.ts theme.extend add a keyframes `marquee` (from translateX(0) to translateX(-50%)) and an animation `marquee: 'marquee 30s linear infinite'`. Alternatively define @keyframes in app/globals.css. Use whichever is cleaner; if using tailwind config, apply via className `animate-marquee`.

Create components/home/MarketDataWidget.tsx. Render a clean horizontal strip / responsive card row of major indices using realistic STATIC illustrative values (free real-time index data needs an API key, which the spec accepts as static): S&P 500, Dow Jones, Nasdaq, Gold, and 10Y Treasury. Each item shows the name, a value, and a change (absolute and/or percent) colored green when up and red when down with an up/down arrow. Add a small muted label/caption noting values are illustrative. Use .card styling or a bordered strip consistent with the site; stack to a grid on mobile (grid-cols-2) and a row on larger screens. Add a code comment noting where to wire a live index API later.

Create components/home/TrustSignals.tsx (NerdWallet/Bankrate style). Render a row of big stat blocks: '7' with label 'Financial Calculators' (note: there are 7 calculator routes: mortgage, 401k, emi, sip, loan-payoff, compound-interest, retirement), '12+' with label 'Major US Banks', 'Daily' with label 'Market News', and '100%' with label 'Free'. Each is an icon (inline SVG or emoji) + big serif number (text-teal-primary) + label. Responsive grid (grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4). Full dark-mode support.

Create components/home/NewsletterSignup.tsx as a 'use client' component. Teal-styled section with heading 'Get the latest finance & crypto news in your inbox' (exact copy), an email <input type=email required> and a Subscribe button (.btn-primary or teal styling). On submit (preventDefault) validate a non-empty email, then show a client-side success message like 'Thanks! You are subscribed.' and clear the input; do NOT actually send anywhere. Add a prominent code comment: connect this to an email service later (Mailchimp / ConvertKit / Resend). Accessible label for the input. Responsive (input + button stack on mobile, inline on larger screens).

Create components/home/FeaturedArticle.tsx (server-compatible, no client hooks needed). Props: featured article (ArticleCard) + an array of sidebar articles (ArticleCard[]). CoinDesk-style layout: a large featured card on the left (roughly 2/3 width on lg) with a large gradient image placeholder (use getCategoryGradient based on the featured article's category slug), a CategoryBadge, a large serif headline linking to /news/[slug], the excerpt, and author/date meta; and a right sidebar (1/3 width on lg) titled e.g. 'More Headlines' listing the sidebar articles as a compact vertical list of headline links (each linking to /news/[slug]) with category label and date, separated by dividers. Reuse components/news/CategoryBadge.tsx. Stack vertically on mobile.

Upgrade components/news/ArticleCard.tsx to be image-rich: always render a thumbnail area at the top (aspect-video) using a category-colored gradient placeholder via getCategoryGradient(article.category?.slug.current) even when article.mainImage is absent (sample articles have no images). Keep the existing CategoryBadge, serif headline link, line-clamped excerpt, and author/date meta below the image. Preserve the .card .card-hover styling and dark-mode variants. Ensure the grid of these cards looks denser/visual like CoinDesk. Do not break existing usages of ArticleCard elsewhere (e.g. app/news/page.tsx).
acceptance_criteria: CryptoTicker is a client component that fetches CoinGecko on mount, refreshes every 60s, colors 24h change green/red, shows BTC/ETH/BNB/SOL/XRP/ADA, and renders static fallback prices when the fetch fails (no crash).
MarketDataWidget renders S&P 500, Dow Jones, Nasdaq, Gold, and 10Y Treasury with up/down colored changes.
TrustSignals renders the four stat blocks (7 Financial Calculators, 12+ Major US Banks, Daily Market News, 100% Free).
NewsletterSignup shows the exact heading copy, validates email, and shows a client-side success message on submit without navigating away.
FeaturedArticle renders a large featured story plus a compact sidebar of additional headlines, both linking to /news/[slug].
ArticleCard always shows a category-colored gradient thumbnail placeholder.
`npm run build` completes with exit code 0 and no type errors.
verification: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; cd /projects/sandbox/Coinscribed.com; npm run build
findings: Implemented all FEAT-002 components without touching app/page.tsx (reserved for FEAT-003). Created lib/category-styles.ts (getCategoryGradient), components/home/{CryptoTicker,MarketDataWidget,TrustSignals,NewsletterSignup,FeaturedArticle}.tsx, and upgraded components/news/ArticleCard.tsx to always render a category-gradient thumbnail. Added marquee keyframes+animation to tailwind.config.ts theme.extend (used via animate-marquee). CryptoTicker is 'use client', fetches CoinGecko on mount + every 60s with cleanup, uses a hardcoded FALLBACK_COINS array on initial render and on any fetch error/non-ok response, and duplicates the coin list so the marquee loops seamlessly (translateX -50%); pause-on-hover via group-hover animation-play-state. NewsletterSignup uses the exact heading 'Get the latest finance & crypto news in your inbox', validates non-empty email, shows 'Thanks! You are subscribed.' client-side, and has a TODO comment to wire Mailchimp/ConvertKit/Resend. MarketDataWidget uses static illustrative index values with a caption + code comment for wiring a live API. Verified: `npm run build` exits 0 with no type errors (postbuild next-sitemap runs normally); `npm run lint` clean. No existing usages broken (app/news/page.tsx still works).
